rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
d = |ax₁+by₁+c|/√(a²+b²)
h² ≥ ab ⟺ real pair
l²+m²+n² = 1

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Straight line" as one blob → ✅ split into: straight line, length of perpendicular from a given point to a given line, bisectors of the angles between two straight lines.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Line: point–slope y − y₁ = m(x − x₁); perpendicular distance from (x₁,y₁) to ax+by+c=0 is |ax₁+by₁+c|/√(a²+b²).  ·  Pair of lines: a·S ≡ ax² + 2hxy + by²; represents a real pair iff h² ≥ ab. Angle between: tanθ = 2√(h²−ab)/(a+b).
